mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% signals economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month moving average
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month MA) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, rising industrial production (INDPRO) above its 3-month trend signals strengthening supply chains and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-recession recovery regime, INDPRO rising above 3-month trend fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 6-month moving average consistently signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above its 6-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure above 800,000 units signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 800.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment in a weak labor market, which typically leads to positive equity returns as investors anticipate policy stimulus and economic stabilization over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing in weak labor market
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 6.5%) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0%), the expectation of higher borrowing costs and reduced liquidity leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
